gates.zh: AuroraView 原生界面 / 停靠
共用能力 / Agent 契约

native.en: An AuroraView native entry and dock have no independent evidence recorded in this matrix.
native.zh: 本矩阵尚未记录 AuroraView 原生入口与停靠的独立证据。

contract.en: Host-specific page calls, events, and explicit Agent tools remain integration work.
contract.zh: 对应宿主的页面调用、事件与显式 Agent 工具仍需配套集成。

example.en: A host-specific AuroraView installation and runnable example remain ecosystem work.
example.zh: 对应宿主的 AuroraView 安装说明与可运行示例仍需配套。

scene.en: No AuroraView scene-state readback is recorded here.
scene.zh: 这里尚未记录 AuroraView 的场景状态回读。

cleanup.en: Owned and borrowed resource cleanup needs host-specific acceptance.
cleanup.zh: 自有与借用资源的清理需要逐宿主验收。

verification.en: Catalog presence is not AuroraView host acceptance.
verification.zh: 目录收录不代表 AuroraView 宿主验收通过。

native.en: Qt host adapter source is available; current native docking and UI acceptance remain pending.
native.zh: 已有 Qt 宿主适配源码；本轮原生停靠与界面验收仍待完成。

contract.en: Merged Outliner source provides explicit page calls and events with tested scene contracts. Shared DCC-MCP Core attachment and Agent discovery remain pending.
contract.zh: 已合并的 Outliner 源码提供显式页面调用与事件，并有场景契约测试；共享 DCC-MCP Core 附着与 Agent 发现仍待实现。

example.en: The refreshed runnable tutorial is merged. Frontend build and reproducible source archive checks passed; interactive installation still needs acceptance.
example.zh: 刷新后的可运行教程已经合并。前端构建和可复现源码包检查通过；交互式安装仍待验收。

scene.en: Eight Maya 2026 mayapy scene checks passed, including full DAG identity, selection, visibility, and callback removal. This does not exercise an interactive WebView.
scene.zh: Maya 2026 mayapy 的 8 项场景检查通过，覆盖完整 DAG 身份、选择、可见性和回调移除；这些检查未运行交互式 WebView。

cleanup.en: All 10 callbacks were released in the Maya scene smoke. Failure-tolerant teardown has tests; interactive WebView close/reopen remains pending.
cleanup.zh: Maya 场景检查释放了全部 10 个回调；异常容错清理已有测试，交互式 WebView 关闭重开仍待验收。

verification.en: Merged revision 59439e0: frontend build, 34 unit tests, eight Maya 2026 scene checks, and source archive verification passed. UI, WebView, native dock, and Core integration are not accepted.
verification.zh: 已合并版本 59439e0：前端构建、34 项单元测试、8 项 Maya 2026 场景检查及源码包验证通过。界面、WebView、原生停靠与 Core 集成尚未验收。

native.en: A real HTML WebView path has been observed. Full native input, DPI, and docking acceptance are still in progress.
native.zh: 已观察到真实 HTML WebView 路径；完整原生输入、DPI 与停靠验收仍在推进。

contract.en: HTML and scene interaction have been observed. The explicit Agent contract and shared runtime integration are tracked separately.
contract.zh: 已观察到 HTML 与场景交互；显式 Agent 契约和共享运行时整合分别跟踪。

example.en: Follow the add-on repository for current install and demo instructions and their host-version limits.
example.zh: 按插件仓库当前安装与演示说明操作，并核对对应宿主版本范围。

scene.en: Real HTML / scene interaction exists; further scenarios need explicit state readback.
scene.zh: 已有真实 HTML / 场景交互；更多场景仍需明确状态回读。

cleanup.en: Full input, DPI, close/reopen, and cleanup acceptance is in progress.
cleanup.zh: 完整输入、DPI、关闭重开和资源清理验收进行中。

verification.en: HTML and scene interaction observed; complete native-host acceptance remains open.
verification.zh: 已观察 HTML 与场景交互；完整原生宿主验收尚未闭合。

native.en: The latest native demo still docks incorrectly and needs correction.
native.zh: 最近一次原生演示的停靠位置仍不正确，需要修复。

contract.en: Page and Agent must reuse declared host capabilities; the current end-to-end contract awaits acceptance.
contract.zh: 页面与 Agent 应复用已声明宿主能力；当前端到端契约待验收。

example.en: Plugin install and demo source are available; the latest dock demonstration still needs a fix.
example.zh: 已有插件安装与演示源码；最近一次停靠演示仍需修复。

scene.en: Scene readback for the corrected native dock demo is pending.
scene.zh: 修正原生停靠演示后的场景回读待完成。

cleanup.en: Host lifecycle and repeatable close/reopen need native acceptance.
cleanup.zh: 宿主生命周期与重复关闭重开仍需原生验收。

verification.en: UE 5.7 and 5.8 native builds passed. The latest dock demo is incorrect; full acceptance is incomplete.
verification.zh: UE 5.7 与 5.8 原生构建通过。最近的停靠演示仍不正确，完整验收尚未完成。

native.en: Windows x64 EditorWindow / child-HWND WebView2 source is public. Native WebView smoke passed; Unity Editor docking acceptance is in progress.
native.zh: Windows x64 EditorWindow / 子 HWND WebView2 源码已公开。原生 WebView smoke 通过；Unity Editor 停靠验收进行中。

contract.en: Reuses the AuroraView JavaScript bridge. An opt-in stdio / named-pipe adapter is a preview example; DCC-MCP Core attachment is planned.
contract.zh: 复用 AuroraView JavaScript 桥。显式启用的 stdio / named-pipe 适配器是预览示例；DCC-MCP Core 附着仍属计划。

example.en: Public README and minimal Unity project provide a Windows Editor preview installation path.
example.zh: 公开 README 与最小 Unity 项目提供 Windows Editor 预览安装路径。

scene.en: Seven Unity 2022.3 Editor tests passed. Browser-to-scene and MCP-to-Editor end-to-end state readback remain pending.
scene.zh: Unity 2022.3 的 7 项 Editor 测试通过；浏览器到场景及 MCP 到 Editor 的端到端状态回读仍待完成。

cleanup.en: Native STA shutdown, current-user pipe access, exclusive ownership, and endpoint close/reopen checks passed. Interactive docking and lifecycle acceptance remain open.
cleanup.zh: 原生 STA 关闭、当前用户管道权限、独占所有权及端点关闭重开检查通过；交互式停靠与生命周期验收仍待完成。

verification.en: Native DLL build, nine Node tests, native WebView2 HWND / IPC / STA and pipe checks, and seven Editor tests passed. End-to-end host acceptance and release publication remain pending.
verification.zh: 原生 DLL 构建、9 项 Node 测试、原生 WebView2 HWND / IPC / STA 与管道检查、7 项 Editor 测试通过；端到端宿主验收与发布仍待完成。

native.en: Houdini host adapter source is available; native UI and docking need version-specific acceptance.
native.zh: 已有 Houdini 宿主适配源码；原生界面与停靠需对应版本验收。

example.en: Use the adapter repository for installation and host prerequisites; a runnable-host result is not recorded here.
example.zh: 按适配器仓库查看安装和宿主前置要求；这里尚未记录可运行宿主结果。

verification.en: Adapter source is available; real-host interaction and cleanup are not assessed in this review.
verification.zh: 已有适配器源码；本轮尚未评估真实宿主交互与资源清理。

native.en: Nuke host adapter and dispatcher source are available; native UI acceptance is version-specific.
native.zh: 已有 Nuke 宿主适配与调度器源码；原生界面验收需对应具体版本。

example.en: Use the adapter repository for installation and dispatcher requirements; a current live-host example is not verified here.
example.zh: 按适配器仓库查看安装与调度要求；这里尚未验证当前真实宿主示例。

verification.en: Adapter source is available; scene readback and lifecycle acceptance are not assessed in this review.
verification.zh: 已有适配器源码；本轮尚未评估场景回读与生命周期验收。
